notes.title: Guidus Zero Update Patch Notes (v2.1.0)
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183955/5f5cbb53bfb04ee4c87b58fc3d8fca571585c522.jpg"]

Hello, this is Guidus Zero.

The long-awaited v2.1.0 update is now live!

This patch includes new content and control improvements we've previously shared through Dev Notes, interviews, and the recent Playtest.

Thanks to your continued support and feedback, Guidus Zero has continued to grow steadily.

We'll keep doing our best to evolve the game into something even more polished—together with you.

Here's a look at the major changes included in the v2.1.0 update:


[hr][/hr]

\[v2.1.0 Key Update Details]

Final Chapter: Abyss
The final chapter of Guidus Zero—Abyss—is now open.

Face new monsters, uncover hidden truths, and witness the conclusion of the story.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183955/a81ebe3fce46d52aa4007f8fe0f3e47b029608a6.gif"]




Final Boss: Valtharos
With the opening of the Abyss, the powerful final boss Valtharos has arrived.

Defeat the new monsters and challenge the ultimate foe that awaits at the end.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183955/fc294fea211adb51148cb70ff5a0a92b48d12ca3.gif"]




Story Ending & Conclusion
The full story of Guidus Zero now comes to a close.

Experience the final chapter and discover the complete ending to your journey.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183955/adc076330b394740b31a7380a1a64c5a4696a434.gif"]




New Room Types (Stages) Added
New types of rooms have been added, offering opportunities like bonus stat boosts and Artifact upgrades.

But beware—these benefits come at a cost, so plan your path strategically.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183955/af8f51b1ca6686a97538017a4be19267543b4da0.png"]


Control System Overhaul
The long-awaited control improvements are finally here!

We've reworked the control system to feel more intuitive and immersive than ever before.

Increased overall attack speed.

Attack animations can now be canceled into movement at any time.

The thrust attack is now mapped to a separate key for better tactical use.

Dodge distance has been increased to 2 tiles and now allows you to pass through enemies.

Holding the Dodge, Attack, or Skill buttons now triggers continuous actions.




Additional Updates
New Challenges have been added.

The Abyss chapter now has entries in the Codex.


[hr][/hr]


That wraps up the major updates in v2.1.0.

We are deeply grateful for your continued support, and we'll keep listening closely to your feedback to make Guidus Zero even better.



Thank you!

notes.title: Guidus Zero Update Patch Notice (v2.0.4)
notes.notes:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183955/fd1f35c893322e16031b92176dff389e1f012c56.jpg"]Hello, this is Guidus Zero.

The v2.0.4 update patch is now live, bringing new content and improvements to the adventure and combat systems—just as previously announced in our update roadmap.

We will continue expanding content and refining systems to enhance the overall gameplay experience further. 
Please check out the key patch details below.



\[v2.0.4 Patch Highlights]
 
Adventure and Combat Improvements

To make the adventure more dynamic, monster waves now appear once per combat room, and the number of rooms per floor has been increased.


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183955/8b0d99892d6790cf622c37d839a505d5acc4045a.png"]

Artifact Upgrade Feature Added
You can now upgrade Artifacts to enhance their abilities. Upgraded Artifacts can also create synergy effects when used together.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183955/7670af26dcc9624f5df540bec0e036c4566c75aa.gif"]



Additional System Changes
Combat and adventure systems have been partially revamped.


Rascal's Shop now includes new items, and drop rates have been adjusted.


Dungeon key drop rates have been adjusted.


Legendary or higher chests now require 2 keys to open.


Entering a Dwarven Gate room now consumes a key.

Bug Fixes
Fixed a display issue in Hazel's ability enhancement screen.


Fixed a bug where quest speech bubbles remained visible under certain conditions.


Resolved an issue where the \[Level Up C] popup appeared even when no Traits were left to level up.


That's all for the major updates in v2.0.4.
Our development team is currently working on new content, bug fixes, control refinements, and the final chapter of the main story, including a brand-new region.
We sincerely thank you for your continued support and enthusiasm. We'll do our best to bring you a more complete and enjoyable Guidus Zero experience.

Thank you.

The v2.0.3 balance patch has been released, and we would like to share the details below.

1. Added a special Decoration as a reward for clearing Hard Mode.
2. Rebalanced combat difficulty for Twilight and above, making Hard Mode more challenging than before.

We'll continue working hard to ensure a smoother and more stable gameplay environment.
Thank you.

notes.title: Guidus Zero – Upcoming Update Plans
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183955/fecfbd28c78024ab9234295f30c1e1b24cdd1794.jpg

Hello, this is Guidus Zero.

Since our official launch on Mar. 26, we've been truly grateful for your overwhelming support and feedback.

We're excited to share our upcoming update plans, shaped by your invaluable insights.
Our focus is to continue improving the overall experience and delivering even richer content.

Game Stabilization & System Improvements
We'll begin by enhancing overall game stability and balance with the following updates:

- Character Trait Reworks & Balance Adjustments
Some characters had unintended overperforming abilities—those Traits will be reworked, and broader balance tuning will continue.

- Spirit System & Hard Mode Difficulty Tuning
Hard Mode will be adjusted to offer a more significant challenge. We're also refining the Spirit system to add more strategic depth to your runs.

- Artifact Balance Overhaul
A major overhaul of the Artifact system is underway.
Full details will be shared in a separate announcement.

- UI/UX Improvements
We're addressing UI elements that hinder gameplay and working toward a more intuitive, seamless experience.

- Bug Fixes & Optimization
Bug fixes and optimization updates will be applied, prioritizing significant issues.

In addition, core elements such as the Key System and the in-game Shop are also being structurally revamped to enhance the overall experience.

New Content Expansion
We're also preparing to expand the content of the game significantly:

- New Chapter 
A brand-new chapter will introduce new areas, enemies, and a new boss tied to the evolving world of Guidus Zero.

- New Playable Characters
Unique new characters with fresh combat styles and tactical elements will be released sequentially.

- New Artifacts
New Artifacts are on the way to enable new builds and strategies.

- New Adventure Elements
In addition to combat-focused rooms, new room types—such as quests, minigames, and challenge objectives—will be introduced to enrich the adventure.

We're steadily expanding the depth and variety of our content to support long-term engagement and build toward a more rewarding adventure.

Looking Ahead
In 2025, we'll continue listening to your feedback and reinforcing what makes Guidus Zero truly special.

Please keep your thoughts and suggestions coming—we're actively monitoring our official Discord and community channels.
Your voice shapes the future of Guidus Zero.

Thank you once again for being on this journey with us.

notes.title: Update Patch Details
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183955/27da7b45c435cf048e3b4497f048597b0b7a39f7.jpg

Hello, everyone!

Thank you so much for your overwhelming interest in Guidus Zero since the Early Access launch.
During the first week, we received valuable feedback and bug reports, which allowed us to address issues that went unnoticed during development. 
We’ve also added convenient features such as customizable key settings and adjustable screen shake intensity.

We’re incredibly grateful to everyone who contributed their insights.
The development team remains committed to delivering ongoing updates, improving stability, and introducing new content to enhance your experience.

Below are the details of the first hotfix update:

New Features
- Added customizable key settings.
- Added an adjustable screen shake intensity option.
- Five new Spirit Bond Effects have been added: Flame Ring, Water Ring, Dust Cloud, Wind Ring, and Lightning Ring.

Known Issues
- Fixed an issue where players could get stuck in passages or rooms intermittently.
- Fixed an issue where monsters spawned double the amount intended.
- Fixed an issue where the amount of Black Blood displayed as a negative value after purchases in Rascal’s Hideout (Shop).
- Fixed an issue where monsters overlapped and could not be attacked.
- Improved the clarity of warning indicators in certain boss patterns.
- Fixed an issue where progress was unavailable when skipping some bosses’ third phases.
- Fixed an issue where bosses would not spawn or be defeated in certain circumstances.
- Fixed an issue where progress was unavailable as the Spirit Bond effect, Wind Veil, removed certain projectiles.
- Revised the Guardian’s Necklace Artifact tooltip to align with its actual effects.
- Fixed an issue where Spirit Bonds would not reveal when acquiring Artifacts through Epsilon’s Artifact Transmitter.
- The Electric Field's discharge direction has been adjusted to a straight line.
- The Rain Shower's area of effect has been expanded, with updated visual effects.
- Fixed an issue where the Phantom Sword effect was not applied to certain monsters.
- Fixed an issue where Divine Punishment targeted already defeated subjects.

Thank you!

notes.title: Guidus Zero Early Access Release Notice
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183955/0bacea984a74b5c8f31cebbda38c005d513a04d4.jpg

Hello, everyone!

"We’re thrilled to share exciting news with everyone awaiting Guidus Zero!
The Early Access release is officially set for Nov. 25, 8:00 PM PST."

The dedicated teams at Izzle and Com2uS Holdings have worked hard to deliver an incredible gameplay experience.

If you’re a fan of pixel graphics and the roguelike genre, be sure to join us on this epic adventure!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183955/c8c72137136199022369df751e3971eb7da39187.jpg

Guidus Zero Overview

In Guidus Zero, you’ll explore the mysterious sinkhole, the "Scar," lying in the continent’s heart, engaging in real-time grid combat and character progression, all set against beautiful top-down pixel graphics.
Team up with an expanding roster of playable heroes, collect artifacts that interact dynamically, and bond with powerful spirits to uncover the dark secrets hidden within the Scar. 

Through research with Hazel, the mage, and camp customization with Solan, the architect, you’ll grow your heroes and prepare for intense boss battles ahead.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183955/62ddfcfbce44156598c39ef10a0dc0008a0c8adb.jpg

Post-Nextfest Changes
During October’s Nextfest, many of you tried out the demo and provided invaluable feedback. Based on your input, we’ve made the following improvements:

- New Region – “Heart of the Labyrinth”: A new area with powerful bosses and unique monsters is now available.
- Enhanced Controls: Improved dodge range and input responsiveness for smoother control.
- Camp Cabin Customization: Customize your cabin with Solan to gain permanent growth benefits.
- Difficulty Adjustment: Overall balance tweaks to enhance gameplay difficulty.
- Hero Balance Updates: Adjustments to stats and skills of playable characters.
- Skill Revamps: Skill balancing for the characters Dalia and Chatri.
- Button Display: Updated button layout and added customization options.
- Growth System Update: Hazel’s upgrade system has expanded from potion boosts to player stat upgrades.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45183955/6ef450fa7acc9ac8df94b5c211c2ad19c3ac1156.jpg

Planned Additions for Official Release
Key additions planned before the official launch:

Enhanced Adventure Elements: Various challenges will be added to enrich the adventure experience beyond combat.

- New Areas: The deepest floors of the Scar will be unveiled.
- New Difficulty Levels: Enjoy new adventures with diverse difficulty options.
- Codex and Scenario: New codex features and scenarios will be included.
- New Playable Characters: Look forward to continuous character additions both at the official release and beyond.
- Hero Traits Revamp: We will introduce more diverse traits than currently available.

"We are committed to developing a polished game experience throughout the Early Access period, incorporating your feedback wherever possible. 
Please share your thoughts and suggestions via the Steam Community Hub or the channels below."

X: https://x.com/JKH41490832

YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@izzleinc.1277

Discord: https://discord.gg/guidus-official-843732954470678539


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072640/_/

"We sincerely appreciate the support you showed during Nextfest and look forward to your continued enthusiasm in Early Access.
Let’s build an even better Guidus Zero together as we move toward the official launch!"

Thank you!
